note: Handler emits done when newCount>=max; with max=3 the loop tag fires on dispatches 1-2 (twice) and done fires once on dispatch 3 - confirmed by both the unit test table and the e2e test's require.Equal(2, loopCount)/require.Equal(1, doneCount). sources: doc=story:rules-doc-accuracy#Role,Capability,Acceptance (internally coherent, no counter-evidence found in design corpus or tensions); code=tools/rulesdoc/rulesdoc_test.go::looksLikeRepoPath#83-105,TestRulesDoc_CitedPathsExist#42-44
note: No dossier or decision exists for this dev-tooling check, but the story's Role/Capability/Acceptance/Falsifier are mutually consistent and unambiguous in promising build-target resolution ('parses every filesystem path and build-target the rules cite, resolves each, and fails if any doesn't exist'; role: 'no stale make target') with no contradicting design evidence anywhere in the corpus. looksLikeRepoPath explicitly excludes any token starting with 'make', so no make target is ever resolved; the only build-target check is a hardcoded strings.Contains(content, 'make core-images'). sources: doc=story:rules-doc-accuracy#Falsifier ('The check accepts a non-existent path'); code=tools/rulesdoc/rulesdoc_test.go::looksLikeRepoPath#83-105
note: Companion gap to id 2335 on the same check. looksLikeRepoPath only recognizes a token as a path if it contains '/' and ends in a trailing '/' or one of {.sh,.yml,.yaml,.md,.go}; go-test path citations ending '...' (e.g. ./test/scenarios/...) and non-whitelisted extensions (.json, .proto, Dockerfile) or extension-less directory citations without a trailing slash are silently skipped from resolution even when missing. The check does perform real os.Stat resolution and a dead-ref blocklist for recognized forms and fails CI via t.Errorf (so it is not merely informational), which is why this is a bounded whitelist hole rather than a fully vacuous check. Queued for Phase 2 (widen looksLikeRepoPath's recognized forms), no story edit.
